verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a cloud LLM inference API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection, data residency controls or regional endpoints. Service tiers, batch and flex processing concern latency, throughput and cost, not where data lives, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
